# The Pilates Programme, Altrincham

> Pilates and Barre teacher training in Altrincham, Greater Manchester. Small cohorts, in-person coaching, Contrology to Contemporary.

Training centre: 23 Central Way, Altrincham, WA14 1RF, UK. Email: info@thepilatesprogramme.co.uk.
Accreditation: internationally accredited by ITTAP through the Pilates Method Alliance (PMA); CIMSPA Training Partner.
Not to be confused with the Irish on-demand app of a similar name. This is the Altrincham, Greater Manchester teacher training provider.

## Teacher training (qualify)
- [Mat Pilates Teacher Training, Manchester](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/become-a-pilates-instructor/mat-pilates-teacher-training): £2,200. A Mat Pilates teacher training in Altrincham, Greater Manchester, covering beginner to advanced repertoire across Contrology, Classical and Contemporary styles. Five in-person days, an online Human Movement course, 80 supported practice hours and three exams, all included for £2,200 or four interest-free payments. No prior qualification is needed.
- [Reformer Pilates Teacher Training, Manchester](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/become-a-pilates-instructor/reformer-pilates-teacher-training): £2,200. A Reformer Pilates instructor course in Altrincham, Greater Manchester, covering beginner and intermediate repertoire with Classical and Contemporary programming. Five in-person days on full apparatus, an online Human Movement course, 80 supported practice hours and three exams, all included for £2,200 or four interest-free payments. No prior qualification needed.
- [Barre Teacher Training, Manchester](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/become-a-pilates-instructor/barre-teacher-training): £2,200. A Barre instructor training in Altrincham, Greater Manchester, blending ballet conditioning with Pilates principles. In-person practical days at our training centre, an online Human Movement course, supported practice hours and exams, all included for £2,200 or four interest-free payments. Suitable for beginners and for Pilates or fitness teachers adding Barre.

## Continuing education (qualified teachers)
- [Advanced Reformer Teacher Training](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/advanced-reformer): Price on request (prerequisite: An existing Reformer teaching qualification). An in-person Advanced Reformer course in Altrincham, Greater Manchester, for teachers who already hold a Reformer qualification. It covers the advanced Classical order and Contemporary progressions, spotting and programming. The manual, exam, online platform access with a 6-week free trial and an interest-free payment plan are all included. Returning students receive 10% off.
- [Chair Pilates Teacher Training](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/chair): £1,200 (prerequisite: An existing Mat or Reformer teaching certification). An in-person Wunda Chair teacher training in Altrincham, Greater Manchester, for teachers with an existing Mat or Reformer certification. It covers Classical repertoire and Contemporary variations with assessment included, for £1,200. Book Cadillac, Chair and Barrels together for £2,700 and Barrels is free.
- [Cadillac Pilates Teacher Training](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/cadillac): £1,500 (prerequisite: An existing Mat or Reformer teaching certification). An in-person Cadillac teacher training in Altrincham, Greater Manchester, for teachers with an existing Mat or Reformer certification. It covers Classical repertoire, springs, bars and straps, and Contemporary variations, with assessment included, for £1,500. Book Cadillac, Chair and Barrels together for £2,700 and Barrels is free.
- [Barrels Pilates Teacher Training](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/barrels): £800 (prerequisite: An existing Mat or Reformer teaching certification). An in-person Barrels teacher training in Altrincham, Greater Manchester, covering the Ladder Barrel, Spine Corrector and Arc for teachers with an existing Mat or Reformer certification. Assessment included, for £800. Barrels is free when you book Cadillac, Chair and Barrels together for £2,700.
- [Cadillac, Chair and Barrels Bundle](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/apparatus-bundle): £2,700 (prerequisite: An existing Mat or Reformer teaching certification). The apparatus bundle combines the Cadillac, Chair and Barrels teacher trainings at The Pilates Programme, Altrincham for £2,700, with Barrels included free. It is for teachers with an existing Mat or Reformer certification who want to teach on full apparatus. Each course includes a manual, video library and assessment.
- [Prenatal and Postpartum Pilates CPD](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/cpd/prenatal-postpartum): £250 (prerequisite: A Pilates or Barre teaching qualification from any provider). A one-day in-person CPD at The Pilates Programme, Altrincham for qualified Pilates and Barre teachers from any provider. It covers pregnancy anatomy, trimester modifications, postpartum return to movement and when to refer, for £250 or two interest-free instalments. Returning students receive 10% off.
- [Strength and Endurance Pilates CPD](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/cpd/strength-endurance): £250 (prerequisite: A Pilates or Barre teaching qualification from any provider). A one-day in-person CPD at The Pilates Programme, Altrincham for qualified Pilates and Barre teachers from any provider. It covers progressive overload, programming for strength and endurance, load and tempo choices and tracking progress, for £250 or two interest-free instalments. Returning students receive 10% off.
- [Jumpboard Pilates CPD (online)](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/cpd/jumpboard-online): £250 (prerequisite: A Reformer teaching qualification from any provider). An online, on-demand Jumpboard CPD from The Pilates Programme, Altrincham for Reformer teachers from any provider. It covers set-up and safety, foot positions and landing mechanics, programming cardio blocks and contraindications, for £250 or two interest-free instalments, with a certificate on completion.
- [Pain Science for Pilates Teachers CPD](https://www.thepilatesprogramme.co.uk/continuing-education/cpd/pain-science): £250 (prerequisite: A Pilates or Barre teaching qualification from any provider). A one-day in-person CPD at The Pilates Programme, Altrincham for qualified Pilates and Barre teachers from any provider. It covers current models of pain, language that helps, graded exposure in a Pilates setting and scope of practice, for £250 or two interest-free instalments. Returning students receive 10% off.
